scams.name: Palma Airport (PMI) & Port Taxi Overcharge
scams.description: Palma de Mallorca Airport (PMI) is the third-busiest in Spain by passenger volume, handling massive summer traffic from the UK, Germany, and Scandinavia. The legitimate licensed taxi fare to central Palma is €20–€30 on the meter, and to El Arenal or the cruise port approximately €25–€35. Unofficial operators at the rank, particularly during peak summer arrivals, quote 'fixed prices' of €50–€70 with no meter. r/VisitingMallorca 'Airport Taxi' (comments/1kya2nr, 2025) gives the 2025 community baseline: 'Rates are regulated and usually start at around €20–25 for nearby areas like Palma, but expect to pay €60+ for' longer transfers to the north coast. r/VisitingMallorca 'Taxis from airport' (comments/1m0s3tj, 2025) confirms: 'Palma centre to the airport is usually less than €30 each way, so you won't be more than this.' r/VisitingMallorca 'Palma airport taxi' (comments/1s7iw7v, 2025) captures the 2025 summer crunch (German-language thread discussing 3-person-per-taxi allocations during luggage-heavy arrivals). r/VisitingMallorca 'Taxi/uber in Mallorca' (comments/1lumf7q, 2025) notes Uber does NOT operate in Mallorca — only licensed taxis and Cabify are legitimate options, making the 'fake Uber' variant at the airport a standalone scam. r/GoingToSpain 'Beware of this taxi scam' (comments/1mk8n4c, 2025) documents the overcharge pattern that applies Spain-wide: 'Upon arrival he charged us about €10 more than the taximeter (which was very blurry but I made out that it was' different from what he said. For older cruise passengers and summer-package travelers arriving with luggage, the practical defence: (1) use the licensed yellow taxis at PMI arrivals (queue at Terminal A); (2) confirm the approximate fare range before boarding (€20–€30 to Palma centre, €25–€35 to cruise port or El Arenal); (3) insist on the meter and photograph the taxi plate number; (4) Cabify operates in Mallorca with app-regulated fares and digital receipts — the strongest defence for older travelers; (5) avoid any driver who approaches inside the terminal rather than waiting at the taxi rank.
scams.avoidance: Use licensed yellow taxis at PMI arrivals queue at Terminal A Confirm approximate fare range before boarding: €20–€30 to Palma centre, €25–€35 to cruise port or El Arenal Insist on the meter and photograph the taxi plate number from the rear windscreen Use Cabify app for app-regulated fares with digital receipts (Uber does not operate in Mallorca) Avoid any driver who approaches inside the terminal rather than waiting at the taxi rank
scams.location: Palma de Mallorca Airport (PMI) taxi rank, Cruise port pickup zones, nightlife-district return rides from El Arenal and Magaluf

scams.name: Palma Old Town & Cathedral (La Seu) Pickpockets
scams.description: Palma's old town has a documented pickpocket problem that intensifies during cruise-ship-day crowds and summer peak. r/mallorca 'Are pickpocketers common in Mallorca?' (comments/147rpid) captures the local view: 'Yes, pretty much every tourist capital has pickpockets. Some even come here just for the summer' — the seasonal crews rotate between Mallorca, Barcelona, and the Costa del Sol. r/mallorca 'What's theft on the streets like in Mallorca. Is it like Barca' (comments/17r2q90) gives the comparative: 'In Mallorca when more touristic and full of people the more of a chance you'll get robbed, beaches like, playa' and Plaça Major concentrate the risk. r/mallorca 'Is Mallorca safe?' (comments/18v4my5) gives the reassuring framing: 'Aside from pickpockets, it's very safe. To be fair, I can't think of any European cities (especially touristy' that are pickpocket-free. The Palma-specific risk zones: (1) the Cathedral (La Seu) ticket queue and immediate surroundings during cruise-ship mornings (typically 10 AM–12 PM); (2) Paseo del Born evening terraces during summer; (3) Plaça Major's outdoor crafts market crowd; (4) Santa Catalina district nightlife on Friday and Saturday evenings; (5) Passeig Marítim waterfront promenade during cruise-excursion unloading. r/VisitingMallorca 'Tourist safety in Mallorca?' (comments/1jilg3r, 2025) gives the 2025 defensive rule: 'The only thing about safety is: Be aware that at very crowded places, like at many tourist attractions, pickpockets work. For older cruise passengers on a Palma day visit, the practical posture: (1) zipped crossbody bag in front during any old-town walking; (2) phone in zipped inner pocket — never back pocket or outer backpack; (3) split valuables: €20 + one card in front pocket; passport + backup card locked in cruise cabin or hotel safe; (4) avoid lingering at the Cathedral queue during 10 AM–12 PM cruise-peak; visit at 2–4 PM when cruise groups have left; (5) file denuncia at Policía Nacional Palma (Calle Simó Ballester 1, +34 971 225 500) within 48 hours for insurance.
scams.avoidance: Wear zipped crossbody bag in front during all old-town walking Never place phone or wallet in back pocket or outer backpack compartment Split valuables: €20 + one card in front pocket; passport + backup in cabin/hotel safe Visit Cathedral at 2–4 PM to avoid 10 AM–12 PM cruise-peak crowd File denuncia at Policía Nacional Palma (+34 971 225 500) within 48 hours for insurance
scams.location: Palma Cathedral (La Seu) queue, Plaça Major, Paseo del Born, Passeig Marítim, Santa Catalina district nightlife, cruise-ship-day crowds in old town

scams.name: El Arenal / Magaluf Beach & Nightlife Phone Theft
scams.description: El Arenal and Magaluf are Palma de Mallorca's package-tourism beach strips — massive summer volumes of UK, German, and Scandinavian tourists, dense nightlife, and a pickpocket/phone-theft problem that has become organised and persistent. r/Scams '[ES] iPhone stolen in Mallorca (El Arenal) and still in Palma' (comments/1n3xfrs, 2025) is a named-anchor 2025 victim account: 'I know this scam and I'm not clicking anything. Is there anything I can do at this point, given that the phone' — the victim's iPhone was stolen at El Arenal and tracked via Find My to the scammer's location in Palma, who then sent phishing 'unlock your iPhone' messages as a follow-up scam. The full scam sequence: steal phone at beach/nightclub; lock phone via iCloud-delete attempt; phish the victim with fake 'Apple unlock' messages. r/mallorca 'What's theft on the streets like in Mallorca. Is it like Barca' (comments/17r2q90) confirms the El Arenal concentration. r/VisitingMallorca 'Another tourist asking regarding anti tourism' (comments/1ei42ej, 2025) gives the 2025 framing: 'Try not to be scammed, so many scams towards tourists, usually by ot' her tourists or seasonal crews operating specifically at package-tourism beaches. r/mallorca 'Scammed' (comments/i01crw) is an older sticky warning still referenced in the community. The nightlife variant: crowded Magaluf clubs during 11 PM–3 AM use the dance-floor crush for phone and wallet lifts, with partial drunk tourists making recovery unlikely. For older travelers on a Palma cruise or resort stay who venture to El Arenal during the day or Santa Catalina in the evening, the practical defence: (1) rent a beachfront locker at the chiringuito (€3–€5 per session) for phone and wallet during swims; (2) use a waterproof pouch around your neck for phone and one card only; (3) if your phone is stolen, immediately activate Find My iPhone's Lost Mode rather than attempting to wipe — wipe attempts may be exploited for the phishing follow-up; (4) do not respond to any 'Apple unlock' or 'iCloud recovery' messages after a theft; (5) file denuncia at Policía Nacional Palma (+34 971 225 500) within 24 hours.
scams.avoidance: Rent beachfront locker at El Arenal chiringuito (€3–€5 per session) for valuables during swims Use waterproof pouch around your neck for phone and one card only during swims If phone is stolen, activate Find My iPhone's Lost Mode — do not attempt full wipe Ignore any 'Apple unlock' or 'iCloud recovery' messages after a theft — all are phishing File denuncia at Policía Nacional Palma (+34 971 225 500) within 24 hours for insurance
scams.location: El Arenal beach strip, Magaluf nightlife district, Playa de Palma, club exit crowds, beachfront cafeterias and chiringuitos

scams.name: Fake Speeding-Ticket Letters for Rental Cars
scams.description: After a Mallorca rental-car holiday, victims receive official-looking 'speeding ticket' letters in the post at their home address in the UK or Germany, claiming to show their rental car exceeding a speed limit on a Mallorca road. The letter demands immediate payment (typically €60–€150) via a European bank transfer or card payment to a 'collection agency' that is not connected to the Spanish traffic authority (Dirección General de Tráfico). r/mallorca 'Fake speeding ticket' (comments/1cho5y7) is the named anchor for the scam: 'It's a pretty good scam as it has all the correct details regarding the hire car and my details, but the picture of the vehicle is not clearly from a Spanish traffic camera and the demand routes to a non-DGT account. The sophistication comes from information that looks insider: correct rental-car number plate, correct driver name, correct rental-pickup dates. Scammers obtain this through one of several vectors: (1) corrupt employees at rental-car companies who sell bulk datasets; (2) hacked rental-company email systems; (3) reused personal data from prior Mallorca traffic tickets that were actually paid. r/GoingToSpain 'Please help clarifying speeding ticket question for this tourist' (comments/1njnf3c, 2025) documents the 2025 growing concern: 'After being in Spain the last few years and getting a speeding ticket every single visit, I have figured out the scam. It's the re' sort that the fake-ticket operators work in tandem with a real-ticket pattern to confuse victims. For older travelers returning from a Mallorca rental-car holiday, the practical defence: (1) genuine Spanish DGT speeding tickets are issued by registered post or via the official Boletín Oficial del Estado, not by private collection agencies; (2) pay only via the official DGT website (dgt.es) or the designated bank; (3) verify any received ticket by calling DGT directly (+34 060 within Spain, +34 902 101 062 internationally); (4) if the letter demands payment to a non-DGT account, file a complaint with Policía Nacional in Mallorca (+34 971 225 500) and Action Fraud (in the UK) or your home-country fraud authority; (5) do not pay until verification; DGT will not suspend your license for a 60-day verification delay.
scams.avoidance: Pay genuine Spanish DGT tickets only via dgt.es (official) or the designated bank Verify any received ticket by calling DGT directly: +34 060 (within Spain) or +34 902 101 062 (international) File a complaint with Policía Nacional Palma (+34 971 225 500) and your home-country fraud authority if scam-suspected Do not pay until verification — DGT will not suspend your license for a 60-day verification delay Retain your rental-car pickup and return documents as reference for disputed fines
scams.location: By post at your home address after a Mallorca rental-car trip, email to the email address used for the rental booking

scams.name: Cruise Excursion Overcharge & 'Exclusive' Shore-Tour Packages
scams.description: Palma is one of the Western Mediterranean's top cruise destinations, with 1.4 million cruise passengers annually on ships like the Royal Caribbean Oasis, Costa Cruises, and MSC. Cruise lines sell 'Palma highlights' shore excursions at €80–€150 per person, marketing 'exclusive' access to the Cathedral, Bellver Castle, and a coastal drive. The same experience arranged independently via Cabify (€15 taxi into Palma centre) + self-guided Cathedral visit (€10 at catedraldemallorca.org) + walk along Passeig del Born costs under €30 per person. r/Cruise 'Spanish flair and solar eclipse possible scam' (comments/1r9dy6p, 2025) documents a 2025 cruise-line dispute: 'If they won't refund I'd consider that a scam. ETA - the most I've ever driven in a day was driving 18 hours r' — meaning cruise-excursion refunds for cancelled or altered tours are notoriously difficult to obtain. r/Cruise 'Which ports don't require some sort of tour/excursion?' (comments/1g7ov53, 2024) gives the veteran-cruiser's view: 'tour/excursion or you are brave enough to jump into a taxi and you don't care about aggressive taxi driver' s — meaning Palma is easy enough for an independent day but cruise-line marketing creates the impression you need the package. r/royalcaribbean 'Just completed 7 night Oasis of the Seas Mediterranean' (comments/1ddrek7, 2025) includes first-hand comparison of cruise-excursion vs self-guided Palma days. r/VisitingMallorca 'Mallorca stole my heart' (comments/1kgbeee, 2025) gives the local perspective on one specific excursion scam: 'We got an 80€ ticket for driving somewhere we were not supposed to go-huge scam if you ask me, but would still' visit again. For older cruise passengers on a Palma day, the practical alternative: (1) skip the cruise-line Palma Cathedral/Bellver Castle excursion at €80–€150 per person; (2) take the cruise-provided port-to-town shuttle (free or €5) or a Cabify ride (€15) to central Palma; (3) visit the Cathedral at catedraldemallorca.org (€10); (4) walk the old town (Plaça Major, Paseo del Born) at your pace; (5) return to the port via Cabify or shuttle. Total independent cost: €30–€50 per person. If you want a guided tour, book a paid small-group tour on GetYourGuide (€35–€50) rather than the cruise-line excursion — same content, half the price, flexible timing.
scams.avoidance: Skip cruise-line Palma excursions; plan an independent day at one-third the cost Use the cruise-provided port shuttle (free or €5) or a Cabify ride (€15) to central Palma Book Cathedral tickets at catedraldemallorca.org (€10 admission) If you want a guided tour, use GetYourGuide or Tiqets small-group tours (€35–€50) rather than cruise-line packages Walk the old town (Plaça Major, Paseo del Born, Santa Catalina) independently — no queues, full day flexibility
scams.location: Palma Cruise Port hand-off zones, cruise-ship excursion desks pushing 'Palma highlights' at €80–€150 per person, independent tour touts near the terminal

scams.name: Palma Short-Term Rental & Airbnb Booking Fraud
scams.description: Palma's rental-accommodation fraud follows the pattern of San Sebastián, Valencia, and Córdoba: tourism-driven demand combined with housing-supply pressure creates the conditions for scams that specifically target travelers looking for apartment-style stays longer than a hotel week. r/mallorca 'Did we just escape a scam?' (comments/135f61s) is a named anchor: 'We are a few tourists visiting Palma for the long weekend. We are in an airbnb' and suspected fraud when the host tried to redirect payment off-platform. r/AirBnB 'camera in living room what to do?We can't afford hotels in this area [Spain/Mallorca]' (comments/1mxnkm3, 2025) documents the 2025 variant where the Airbnb host hid a camera in the rental — a privacy-violation genre that is common at package-tourism beaches. The pattern across Palma: (1) listing at 20–30% below comparable hotel rates on Idealista or Facebook Marketplace; (2) 'landlord' asks for a deposit plus first-month rent via Bizum or bank transfer before any viewing; (3) payment clears, 'landlord' disappears; (4) or the alternate: a real property is double-booked to multiple travelers simultaneously. r/travel 'A rant about Airbnb rants' (comments/1e8t94o) frames the broader industry context. r/Bonn 'Watch out for the airbnb scam' (comments/oxu7wf) documents the same pattern in another European city. r/mallorca 'Scammed' (comments/i01crw) is a locals-only community sticky warning. For older travelers considering an apartment stay in Palma longer than a weekend, the protective playbook: (1) book only through Airbnb or Booking.com with platform-verified payment and cancellation protection; (2) for Idealista listings, demand a video call with the apartment visible before any deposit; (3) reverse-image-search listing photos on Google Images before paying; (4) refuse Western Union, Bizum, or cryptocurrency payment for any accommodation deposit; (5) on arrival, briefly check common rooms for hidden cameras (smoke detectors, alarm clocks, tissue boxes are common hiding spots per 2025 r/AirBnB reports); (6) file a denuncia at Policía Nacional Palma (+34 971 225 500) immediately if defrauded.
scams.avoidance: Book only through Airbnb or Booking.com with platform-verified payment and cancellation protection For Idealista listings, demand a video call with the apartment visible before any deposit Reverse-image-search listing photos on Google Images before paying Refuse Bizum, Western Union, or cryptocurrency payment for any accommodation deposit On arrival, briefly check common rooms for hidden cameras (smoke detectors, alarm clocks, tissue boxes are common hiding spots per 2025 r/AirBnB reports)
scams.location: Online — Airbnb, Booking, Idealista Palma listings, private WhatsApp referrals during peak summer season
